title: Patch with a different compression history
edit: A 192x128 px patch at x=120, y=400 was saved at JPEG quality 50, pasted back, and the whole image saved at quality 95.

title: JPEG ghost of an earlier quality-60 save
edit: Same kind of edit: a 192x128 px patch at x=120, y=400 saved at quality 60, pasted in, whole image saved at quality 90.

title: Region smoothed with a retouch brush
edit: An iPhone 5c photo (of a watercolour painting) with an 800x600 px region at x=1300, y=900 smoothed by a Gaussian blur (sigma 1.5), as a denoise or retouch brush would. Saved at quality 92.

title: Matched to its camera by sensor noise
edit: An unedited iPhone 5c photo. Its sensor fingerprint is compared with one built from three other photos taken with the same phone, which the app loads as references automatically.

title: Cloned block of the city
edit: The 192x128 px block at x=120, y=400 was copied to x=700, y=300. Saved at quality 95. The two smaller cloud clones it also finds were already in the original sample, which is itself a composite.

title: Image enlarged 1.5x
edit: The whole image was enlarged 1.5x with bicubic interpolation and saved as PNG.

title: Contrast stretched
edit: Levels were stretched (value = (value - 60) x 1.6) and the result saved as PNG.

title: Data hidden in the lowest bits
edit: Random bits were written into the least significant bit of 40 % of the pixel values (a payload of 0.4 bits per pixel), saved as PNG.

title: Contradictory camera metadata
edit: EXIF claims a Canon EOS 5D Mark IV, names Adobe Photoshop as the software, and gives a modification date six weeks before the capture date.
